title: InferenceRun
description: A model applied to a set of cases. Records which model, which cases, and which Annotation documents the run produced. The output Annotations are the user-facing artefact; the InferenceRun is the bookkeeping that ties them together so 'all model X outputs from run Y' is a single query.

project_id.description: The Project this run targets. Output Annotations are scoped to this Project.

case_ids.description: The cohort case_ids this run targeted. Output Annotations should be created for every case_id; missing ones indicate per-case failures.

output_annotation_ids.description: Annotations produced by this run, one per successful case. Filled in after the run completes.

hardware.description: Free-form hardware fingerprint of the machine that ran inference.
